import math
import unittest

from solution import humidex_celsius


class HumidexTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def expected(self, temperature, dewpoint):
        pressure = 6.11 * math.exp(
            5417.7530 * (1 / 273.16 - 1 / (dewpoint + 273.15))
        )
        return temperature + 0.5555 * (pressure - 10.0)

    def test_formula_without_rounding(self):
        value = humidex_celsius(30, 20)
        self.assertIsInstance(value, float)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(value, self.expected(30, 20), places=12)

    def test_valid_boundaries(self):
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            humidex_celsius(20.0, 20.0), self.expected(20.0, 20.0), places=12
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            humidex_celsius(25, 25), self.expected(25, 25), places=12
        )

    def test_invalid_physical_ranges_return_nan(self):
        self.assertTrue(math.isnan(humidex_celsius(19.999, 10)))
        self.assertTrue(math.isnan(humidex_celsius(25, 25.001)))

    def test_nonfinite_reals_return_nan(self):
        for temperature, dewpoint in [
            (math.nan, 10),
            (math.inf, 10),
            (-math.inf, 10),
            (25, math.nan),
            (25, math.inf),
            (25, -math.inf),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(temperature=temperature, dewpoint=dewpoint):
                self.assertTrue(math.isnan(humidex_celsius(temperature, dewpoint)))

    def test_malformed_types_raise_type_error(self):
        for temperature, dewpoint in [
            (True, 10),
            (25, False),
            ("25", 10),
            (25, None),
            (1 + 2j, 10),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(temperature=temperature, dewpoint=dewpoint):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    humidex_celsius(temperature, dewpoint)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
